prompt: Mauro laughs because his old donkey runs (much / fast) than the young horses.
explanation_ru: Для усиления сравнительной степени наречия fast используется модификатор much: much faster (намного быстрее).

prompt: Our green library van lent by far (tall) pile of travel books on Friday.
explanation_ru: Модификатор by far усиливает превосходную степень, перед которой нужен определённый артикль: by far the tallest.

prompt: On Saturday, the new car park camera sent out (far / many) fine notices than usual, even catching the library van.
explanation_ru: Перед существительным во множественном числе сравнительная степень от many — more, а усилитель far ставится перед ней: far more.

prompt: Dry weather hit the valley hard, so farmers looked for better ways to water their fields. A local grower built a solar water pump that ran a lot (quietly) than the old petrol machines. It used (much / little) energy and saved by far (large) amount of river water in the region. Neighbours hope to build two more pumps before summer.
explanation_ru: Сравнение глагола с модификатором a lot требует наречия more quietly; с неисчисляемым energy используется much less; после by far нужна превосходная степень the largest.

prompt: Honestly, Grandma's old pot isn't fancy, yet it works ___ than ours.
explanation_ru: Сравнительную степень нельзя усиливать словом very (частая ошибка русскоязычных) и нельзя удваивать через more; правильно — much better.

prompt: Did the quiet Sunday bakery show really pull in easily (high) weekend audience on our channel this year?
explanation_ru: Слово easily здесь усиливает превосходную степень, поэтому требуется артикль the и суффикс -est: easily the highest.

prompt: That small fish-burger bike sells out (even / quickly) than the big beach cafes.
explanation_ru: Наречие quickly образует сравнительную степень через more, а усилитель even (ещё) ставится в начале: even more quickly.

prompt: This autumn, Spencer's lantern picnic drew by far the most biggest crowd in the park, lining the stone paths with paper lights.
answer: This autumn, Spencer's lantern picnic drew by far the biggest crowd in the park, lining the stone paths with paper lights.
accepted_answers: This autumn, Spencer's lantern picnic drew by far the biggest crowd in the park, lining the stone paths with paper lights.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — двойная превосходная степень the most biggest; у короткого прилагательного big достаточно суффикса -est: by far the biggest.

prompt: I always use the corner chemist because their colour-coded bags make daily vitamins a bit (easy) for my grandparents to sort.
explanation_ru: После модификатора a bit стоит сравнительная степень прилагательного easy с заменой y на i: a bit easier.

prompt: After months of careful cleaning, Farida confirmed that the market list written on a dry leaf is (second / old) complete record in the desert museum.
explanation_ru: Порядковое числительное перед превосходной степенью требует артикля the и формы -est: the second-oldest (второй по древности).

prompt: We loved our quiet little hotel on the hill. The baker left fresh fruit outside our door, which didn't cost extra. The shaded orange garden felt (far / calm) than the busy town centre. For us, it was easily (good) stay of our trip.
explanation_ru: При сравнении двух мест с модификатором far нужна сравнительная степень (far calmer), а после easily в значении «безусловно» — превосходная форма the best.

prompt: Well done to our new driver, who learned the street postcodes ___ than anyone in last year's group.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень наречия fast (faster) усиливается через a lot; варианты very faster, more much faster и more quick — частые ошибки.

prompt: Wasn't the painted mask show easily (popular) family event in the museum?
explanation_ru: После усилителя easily и при сравнении среди всех событий музея нужна превосходная степень длинного прилагательного: the most popular.

prompt: Over five hundred people danced in the seaside square when the local band played, beating every turnout there since 2006. Which report sentence fits best?
options: The band drew by far the bigger dancing crowd the square has seen in twenty years.
The band drew easily the biggest dancing crowd the square has seen in twenty years.
The band drew very the biggest dancing crowd the square has seen in twenty years.
The band drew much biggest dancing crowd the square has seen in twenty years.
explanation_ru: Для рекорда за двадцать лет нужна превосходная степень the biggest, которую корректно усиливает easily; by far the bigger, very the biggest и пропуск артикля неверны.

prompt: Class Four stacked their lunch trays (slightly / neatly) than the older pupils.
explanation_ru: Действие stacked описывается наречием neatly; его сравнительная степень — more neatly, а модификатор slightly (чуть-чуть) стоит перед ним.

prompt: No other bean plant in the greenhouse is nearly as long as Neville's one. → Neville's bean plant is by far …
answer: Neville's bean plant is by far the longest in the greenhouse.
accepted_answers: Neville's bean plant is by far the longest in the greenhouse.
Neville's bean plant is by far the longest one in the greenhouse.
Neville's bean plant is by far the longest bean plant in the greenhouse.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «ни одно другое не так длинно, как…» передаётся превосходной степенью с усилителем by far: by far the longest.

prompt: I bought a cordless drill from the corner hardware shop to build heavy porch shelves. It didn't need a single charge all afternoon, which surprised me. The motor runs (a lot / smoothly) than my old corded one, and the handle feels (slightly / light) in the hand. It isn't the cheapest tool on the shelf, yet it works (still / well) under heavy wood.
explanation_ru: Для глагола runs нужно наречие a lot more smoothly, после feels — прилагательное slightly lighter, а для усиления сравнительной степени от well используется still better.

prompt: Wearing her sister's spare skates on the frozen lake, the young girl finished (still / fast) than the defending champion and broke the town record.
explanation_ru: Модификатор still перед сравнительной степенью наречия fast означает «ещё быстрее»: still faster.

prompt: After adding a quick photo search for market stalls, the local shopping app became ___ tool in the region.
explanation_ru: Для второго места в рейтинге используется the second most downloaded; модификаторы very и a lot не сочетаются с превосходной степенью, а после by far нужна превосходная форма.

prompt: Wolfgang says the yellow bus is more much popular than the blue one.
answer: Wolfgang says the yellow bus is much more popular than the blue one.
accepted_answers: Wolfgang says the yellow bus is much more popular than the blue one.
explanation_ru: Частая ошибка — неверный порядок слов more much; усилитель much всегда ставится перед more: much more popular.

prompt: Bright June skies brought visitors from across Europe to the small island terminal. According to Jim's summer report, the airport handled far (many) passengers than in any previous spring, while flight delays fell sharply. It was by far (busy) month since the new runway opened. Local hotels also filled (even / early) than usual, leaving almost no empty beds.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым passengers используется far more, после by far нужна превосходная степень the busiest, а с глаголом filled — наречие even earlier.

prompt: Nobody expected students to borrow by far (high) number of overnight books in thirty years during the spring challenge.
explanation_ru: Выражение by far и ограничение in thirty years указывают на превосходную степень: by far the highest.

prompt: After mild sunny weeks in the castle park, the red maple leaves reached peak colour much (late) than normal.
explanation_ru: После модификатора much перед than требуется сравнительная степень наречия времени late: much later.

prompt: Last summer, Brent asked our downtown office to cut waiting times on insurance renewals. We didn't hire extra staff, yet we simplified our main forms on the computer. Within a month, our team processed applications much (quickly) than any other regional branch. In the end, we achieved easily (good) renewal speed in the company, with far (few) mistakes on file.
explanation_ru: Глагол processed требует наречия much more quickly, после easily ставится превосходная степень the best, а с исчисляемым mistakes — far fewer.

prompt: Scott's farm roof made ___ clean power in the whole valley.
explanation_ru: Для максимума среди всех ферм долины нужна превосходная степень с by far: by far the most; варианты с the more и very перед превосходной степенью ошибочны.

prompt: Although my student flat doesn't have a wide hallway, this folding wooden shoe rack takes up far (little) floor space than any solid bench I tried in town.
explanation_ru: Существительное floor space неисчисляемое, поэтому после усилителя far используется сравнительная форма от little: far less.

prompt: Please borrow a free wool blanket at the stairs, because the mountain breeze gets much (cold) right after sunset.
explanation_ru: После глагола gets и усилителя much ставится сравнительная степень короткого прилагательного cold: much colder.

prompt: Have you tried the warm bean bread at that brick tavern near the bridge? Most visitors order the cold meat plates by mistake. The fresh bread comes out of the oven (a bit / slowly), yet it tastes far (delicious) than anything else on the menu. I always share two loaves with friends.
explanation_ru: Глагол comes out требует наречия a bit more slowly, а после глагола-связки tastes и модификатора far используется прилагательное more delicious.

prompt: We hired two local guitar players whose music sounded much softer than a full band during my grandmother's toast.
answer: We hired two local guitar players whose music sounded much softer than a full band during my grandmother's toast.
accepted_answers: We hired two local guitar players whose music sounded much softer than a full band during my grandmother's toast.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: усилитель much правильно стоит перед сравнительной степенью прилагательного softer.

prompt: Two hundred young people gave blood on Saturday, more than any other day this year. Which sentence is right?
options: Saturday brought by far the bigger crowd of young donors this year.
Saturday brought very the biggest crowd of young donors this year.
Saturday brought by far the biggest crowd of young donors this year.
Saturday brought much the bigger crowd of young donors this year.
explanation_ru: При сравнении всех дней года нужна превосходная степень the biggest с усилителем by far; the bigger и very с превосходной степенью не подходят.

prompt: Don't visit the old harbour castle at noon. Huge tour groups pack the narrow bridge right after lunch. Walk along the stone walls at sunrise instead, when the air feels much (cool). You will also see far (few) people and get lovely photos.
explanation_ru: После much нужна сравнительная степень прилагательного cooler, а перед исчисляемым существительным people — far fewer.

prompt: Although I have worked in four seasonal hotels, this hillside guesthouse is by far the better summer job I have had, with free breakfasts that never run late.
answer: Although I have worked in four seasonal hotels, this hillside guesthouse is by far the best summer job I have had, with free breakfasts that never run late.
accepted_answers: Although I have worked in four seasonal hotels, this hillside guesthouse is by far the best summer job I have had, with free breakfasts that never run late.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о выборе из четырёх мест работы, поэтому после by far нужна превосходная степень the best, а не сравнительная the better.

prompt: Because freezing air stops liquid ink within minutes, wooden pencils write ___ than gel pens when we record outdoor notes.
explanation_ru: Глагол write требует наречия reliably, а для усиления сравнительной степени используется far (far more reliably), а не very или more much.

prompt: Walking through the park is much faster than taking the temporary shuttle van during roadworks. → Taking the temporary shuttle van during roadworks is much …
answer: Taking the temporary shuttle van during roadworks is much slower than walking through the park.
accepted_answers: Taking the temporary shuttle van during roadworks is much slower than walking through the park.
explanation_ru: При смене сравниваемых сторон much faster заменяется антонимом much slower с сохранением союза than.

prompt: Looking for a place to read while repairs buzz near the main doors? Please head up to the sunny fourth-floor tables, where you can study much (quietly) than downstairs. The third floor is slightly (close) to the stairs, yet the top room stays easily (peaceful) space in the whole building. Spare lamps sit beside the lift if it gets dark.
explanation_ru: С глаголом study требуется наречие much more quietly, после slightly — прилагательное closer, а с easily в пределах всего здания — превосходная степень the most peaceful.
